# Bitcoin Cycle Workbench

> Agent-readable Bitcoin cycle research dashboard with on-chain context, macro/video insight synthesis, and educational signal explanations. Not financial advice.

Homepage: http://cycle.lombardo.life/
MCP discovery manifest: http://cycle.lombardo.life/.well-known/mcp.json
Research catalog: http://cycle.lombardo.life/mcp/research-catalog.json

## What this site provides
- Live public BTC price/candle context in the browser
- Educational cycle posture framing: Accumulation / Neutral / Overheated / Risk-Off
- Metric explainers for Puell Multiple, MVRV, realized price, exchange reserves, LTH/STH, Pi Cycle, volume, and moving averages
- Planned MCP/x402/Lightning paid endpoints for structured actionable research insights from Bitcoin/macro/on-chain video processing

## Intended agent use
Use this as research context and source-labeled educational synthesis. Do not treat it as investment advice, trade execution, or individualized financial recommendation.

## Planned MCP tools
- get_cycle_posture
- get_actionable_research_insights
- compare_cycle_indicators
- explain_metric_relevance

## Payment model planned
Free preview now. Future paid MCP/API calls may use x402 or Lightning micropayments for fresh insight bundles and deeper source-linked research synthesis.
